title: Mist Trail: Vernal and Nevada Falls
paragraphs: The route also reaches John Muir Trail. Attention also goes to Yosemite's Mist Trail and Nevada Fall, with the guide attaching a story to each stop. Among the places guests actually encounter are Yosemite's Mist Trail, Nevada Fall, and John Muir Trail. Guests do not travel by bus or by boat. They stand at the sites while the explanation is given.

Guests keep walking while that account is given, moving at the guide's pace. The explanation happens outdoors, in front of the buildings, and the group moves on only after it is given. Each pause is there so guests can look at the place the story belongs to.

facts.meetingAddress: Shuttle Stop 14, Curry Village, Yosemite, CA
facts.description: On this guided hike, you'll conquer the heart-pounding Half Dome cables and earn breathtaking views at the summit. This is a bucket-list achievement!
facts.detailsText: Packing List: • Lunch • Snacks & Electrolytes • Sun Hat • Sunglasses • Water Bottle (3L per person, but you can start the hike with just one full) • Sunscreen • Bug spray • Raincoat & Warm Layer • Headlamp (We will start before sunrise) For the Half Dome Cables • Gloves: Any kind of work, gardening or climbing gloves to help you grip the cable. • Boots or Trail Running Shoes: The cable climb is very steep and slippery. Your shoes must have great traction. No sneakers. Optional: • Cash, to tip your guide We will provide backpacks, trekking poles, water filter, & first aid kit
